description: REQUIRES prior ibk_fast_account__session__login call with same account_link_id. Read the balance and daily summary for one registered IBK bank account. Files: a document generated from this result, as Excel (xlsx) only when requested in output_formats, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

bank_account_credential_id.description: bank_account_credential_id of one registered account - take it from this bank's accounts list tool

output_formats.description: Optional. Also return this result as a file (Excel (xlsx)) in artifacts[] of the result. Omit it for data only.

name: ibk_fast_account__accounts__quick_summary__get
title: IBK 빠른계좌조회 잔액 요약
